_why: The mechanisms still written twice, each with the reason it stands and what would close it. Recorded by npm run lint:mechanism -- --record, which leaves the reason blank; a pair with no reason fails, because a pair carried without one is the silence this check exists to end. A pair not in this file fails outright: the number only falls. Ten on 2026-09-02, seven that afternoon when the list keyboard became one mechanism, one on 2026-09-03 when the geometry read did, and none by that evening, when putting focus into a layer and giving it back became one too.
